properties.name: SETTLED 2026-10-06 — a hub member's relation is a FIELD on its existing dependency pin (no new edge type, no schema-wide upgrade), and the first build is the ripple only; a parent's intent flowing down into its parts comes later
properties.rationale: The pin is where a hub's member list already lives (upstream_status reads it), so the relation joins the record every reader meets, without a schema stamp move. Ripple first because it is the measured gap (fact:root-cause-a-blast-radius-stops-at-its-design-by-design-and-nothing-says-where-it-left-2026-10-05); allocation across designs is larger and rests on two open ideas.
